title: DNS resolver hardcoded to Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 — breaks split-horizon and air-gapped deploys
description: MessageAuthenticator::new_cloudflare() in server.rs hardcodes 1.1.1.1 as the resolver. No config option to override. Scenario: operator uses internal DNS with split-horizon (SPF/DKIM TXT records only visible from corporate network), or is in an environment that blocks 1.1.1.1 for compliance reasons. Behavior: all SPF/DKIM/DMARC lookups fail silently → auth disabled via the warn\!() fallback path. Operator has no way to diagnose this. Maintenance consequence: issue reports from every enterprise or air-gapped deployment that gets silently broken auth. Fix: add a resolver config option (system resolver as default is safer than Cloudflare-hardcoded).
